utility.notes: The City of Bend's own franchise ordinance (No. NS-2346) states directly: 'PacifiCorp dba Pacific Power (Pacific Power) provides electric power distribution utility services in a portion of the City of Bend.' A separate City electrification-policy study estimated the City's electric utility mix as weighted approximately 85% Pacific Power and 15% Central Electric Cooperative (CEC) — Bend is a genuine two-utility city, similar in structure to Phoenix (APS/SRP) and Mesa (municipal/SRP). This record is scoped to the Pacific Power-served majority only; Central Electric Cooperative customers within Bend are NOT covered by this record and would need independent verification of CEC's own interconnection process.
